methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly via WebFetch for each vendor: envoy.com/pricing, swipedon.com/pricing, signinapp.com/pricing, greetly.com/plans, vizito.eu/pricing, and eptura.com/pricing (for Eptura Visitor / formerly Proxyclick). Compliance pages verified directly: envoy.com/security, envoy.help/en/articles/4263393-envoy-hipaa (HIPAA explicitly denied, no BAAs), signinapp.com/data-security and signinapp.com/hipaa-visitor-management (BAA available from day one), vizito.eu/security, greetly.com/trust-center. Sign In App publishes in GBP on its official pricing page (£415/£835/£1,255 per site/year); USD monthly-equivalents ($50/$100/$150) are corroborated from Capterra's USD listing ($600/$1,200/$1,800 per year). The Receptionist for iPad was acquired by Sign In Solutions and is now branded under Sign In App. Eptura Visitor (formerly Proxyclick, rebranded 2025) is confirmed quote-only with no self-serve published prices. SwipedOn publishes USD per-site annual prices. Vizito publishes EUR prices (€29.95/€59.95/€99.95 per location/month); the numeric values are retained as near-parity USD with the EUR origin disclosed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

SOC 2 Type II and GDPR confirmed at envoy.com/security. 14-day Visitors free trial confirmed via Envoy help center.
